title: The Laestrygonians (on the sea kit)
part: The sea kit in the harbour, three hulls
hypothesis: The trap reads if the viewer sees the harbour's shape once from above and then looks down the water to its mouth, so the escape through it is a place he can point to; and the men stay on their ships.
variable: look.sea on every key (a calm golden harbour, the rocks' swell, the escape's sweep and wake; the three hulls ridden; an overhead and a waterline camera path; offstage windows; benches); Odysseus on his own ship's stern; the scouts re-blocked; the hull riders set per hull in the director's module and the beached ship unrigged; the sheet recompiled.

metrics_after.clip: CLIP OD-B10-S02 visible 0.0 s in 0 intervals

checks.test: the geography is established once from above, then the waterline toward the mouth; the viewer can point to the exit
checks.note: 0-7.4 s an overhead (the kit's camera path) shows the ring of cliffs, the two ships inside and Odysseus's ship in the gap at the bottom; 7.45-12 s a low view along his ship's bow to the mouth, cliffs either side and the open sea beyond. The waterline view is from just over his bow, not at the water: the mouth is narrow and his ship fills it, so the open sea is a band between the cliffs

checks.test: no one runs through anything: Odysseus on his own deck, not in the mast or the hull; the scouts not through the mast or each other; the eaten scout not inside the giant
checks.note: tools/metis/clip.js on the take: 0 visible intervals. Before the fixes: 10.2 s in 9 intervals and earlier more (Odysseus standing in his ship's mast and sunk in its deck, the scouts walking through the mast and each other, the eaten scout inside the giant's head). The rig of the beached ship turned all three hulls (the player finds a rig's hull by a label containing its own, and 'black ship' is in all three), which sank men into decks; it is now ridden by the kit instead. The scouts re-blocked on the walkways off the mast's line; the swallowed scout off stage from 19.1 s; the two who escape off stage while they run (22.6-28.75 s) and seated on thwarts aboard after

checks.test: three hulls ride the sea, the oars cut from each
checks.note: each hull's turn kept as the sheet's player lays it (or the kit's for the beached one), its water stepped down under it and its own oars swept on the escape's clock

result: Published as take 2. The harbour is seen from above once, then along Odysseus's bow to the mouth; the ships ride the sea; nobody walks through a mast, a hull or another man. Loose: the waterline view is over his bow, not at the water; the scouts who escape vanish while running and reappear seated aboard; the swallowed scout vanishes into the giant's mouth; one shot at 27.8 s frames only sea and a hull edge; the sheet recompiled on the current engine.
